title: Sunday Sweet Rice Pilaf
description: A comforting, easy-to-make pilaf perfect for a lazy Sunday. Sweet and savory flavors blend in this delightful dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the ground cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir to coat with the oil and spices.
Add the sweet corn kernels and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
